newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Banco de Credito to issue 25 mln sol bonds.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Banco de Credito to issue 25 mln sol bonds.

text.p: Banco de Credito, Peru's leading commercial bank, plans to issue 25 million soles ($9.4 million) worth of subordinated bonds on local markets May 12, the Lima stock exchange announced Monday.
The issue will be the first in a global program approved last month to issue $100 million bonds.
Subordinated bonds permit the issuer to use proceeds to raise effective equity, equity and risk-weighted assets.
Banco de Credito is 90.1 percent owned by Credicorp Ltd, a holding firm made up of shares of Credito, Peruvian insurer El Pacifico Peruano Suiza and offshore Atlantic Security Bank.
